description: This file defines the interface and bindings for the Generator component in PyTorch, including Python wrapper structures and functions for creating, wrapping, and unwrapping generator objects.

classes.name: THPGenerator
classes.description: A Python object structure that wraps the internal at::Generator object, enabling interaction between C++ and Python.

methods.name: THPGenerator_initDefaultGenerator
methods.description: Creates a new Python wrapper object around a default at::Generator, with a borrowed reference.

methods.name: THPGenerator_Check
methods.description: Checks if a given Python object is an instance of the THPGenerator class.

methods.name: THPGenerator_Wrap
methods.description: Wraps an at::Generator into a Python object for Python interaction.

methods.name: THPGenerator_Unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps a Python object to retrieve the underlying at::Generator.

methods.name: THPGenerator_NewWithVar
methods.description: Creates a new Python Generator object associated with a given at::Generator, which must not already have a Python wrapper.

methods.name: THPGenerator_init
methods.description: Initializes the generator module within Python.
